name: Clean Architecture (Onion / Concentric)
catalog_source: Martin (2017), Clean Architecture; Palermo (2008), Onion Architecture
forces_resolved: Strict Dependency Inversion Principle: dependencies point only inwards toward domain entities
Domain logic completely agnostic of database, web framework, and UI delivery mechanisms
High maintainability, modularity, and comprehensive testability with test doubles
forces_unresolved: Data transformation layer proliferation (Entities -> Domain Models -> Use Cases -> Presenters)
Significant ceremony and conceptual overhead for junior engineers
applicability_conditions: Enterprise backend systems with heavy business policies and compliance rules
Teams aiming for high code coverage (> 85%) and isolated domain testing
Projects with expected lifecycle > 5 years requiring framework independence
anti_requisites: Simple throwaway prototypes or MVPs with tight delivery deadlines (< 1 month)
Flat data pipeline without complex domain rules
